ratios.quote: Consolidated Net Total Leverage Ratio (as defined by our Credit Agreement) 2.00
Consolidated Net Interest Coverage Ratio (as defined by our Credit Agreement) 8.72

parsed.notes: Leverage limit is 4.00:1.00, with a possible step up to 4.50:1.00 under certain circumstances. Net leverage offsets up to $150M of unrestricted cash. Both ratios are trailing twelve months using Consolidated EBITDA as defined by the Credit Agreement ($798.4M), which includes pro forma and other adjustments. The leverage ratio also sets the TLA margin and the unused revolver fee.
